description: B-8 (jiggly-greeting-crystal.md): extends part07-04-actgrp-cl's F0704A confirmation (which only ever CALLed it once) with the full activation-group contrast f0704s.rpgle's own header describes but was never actually run: CALL PGM(F0704A) twice in the SAME job (expect bumpCounter 1,2,3 then CONTINUING 4,5,6 - F0704A is compiled ACTGRP('F0704AG'), a named, non-*NEW activation group that survives a normal return), then RCLACTGRP ACTGRP(F0704AG) (must run from a separate step, after both CALLs have returned), then a THIRD CALL PGM(F0704A) (expect RESET back to 1,2,3). Also builds a *CALLER-bound comparison object, F0704AC, from the SAME source member (src/qrpglesrc/f0704s.rpgle) via CRTRPGMOD (module has no fixed activation group) + CRTPGM ACTGRP(*CALLER) (this OVERRIDES whatever the module's own ctl-opt said, per cl_commands_75.txt's CRTPGM ACTGRP parameter description - CRTBNDRPG-only ctl-opt ACTGRP is a CRTBNDRPG-specific keyword, ilerpgref75.txt line ~24173-24191, f0704s.rpgle's own header already flags this), CALLed twice in the same job to see whether *CALLER (running in the harness's own top-level CL wrapper's activation group) behaves like the named-activation-group case across separate CALLs in the same job - f0704s.rpgle's own header flags this as an explicit unconfirmed TODO. All CALLs use SNDPGMMSG/QMHSNDPM (job log), not QSYSPRT, so the existing vfylog/JOBLOG_INFO collection mechanism is reliable here - no run-section-reading workaround needed for this batch.

steps.label: CPF0704ACP
steps.cmd:
DLTPGM PGM(&LIB/F0704AC)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)
CRTPGM PGM(&LIB/F0704AC) MODULE(&LIB/F0704AC) ACTGRP(*CALLER)
